newsitem.title: UK: R-OPTIONS - ASDA Group calls active.
newsitem.headline: R-OPTIONS - ASDA Group calls active.

text.p: Calls in supermarket operator ASDA Group Plc were active on Tuesday amid persistant hopes that the company will emerge a winner in the competitive UK supermarket sector, traders said. In the January 120p calls, volume rose to 1,220 lots, while in the April 120p calls some 1,820 lots were dealt, helping lift the underlying stock 1p to 119.

Retailer Kingfisher was also active with dealers noting a straddle trade involving the purchase of 800 February 650 calls and a similar number of puts, in what appeared to be a bet on increased volatility in the stock ahead of Christmas.
